selection_policy: Explicit F600-F2 train-only; disjoint from S600-common-400 families/snapshots/instances; normalize eligible only.

mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: directed serialization aliases the live opcode store; result side and live store are identical (is) so later filtering/mutation leaks across the boundary
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Rebuild filtered opcode copies for the directed branch; alias only in the undirected branch.
mechanism_evidence.contract: Directed delta serialization rebuilds filtered opcode copies; the result side is not the live store (is-not), mutating the result side leaves the live store untouched, captured at _to_delta_dict call timepoint.

discriminating_observation.description: import deepdiff.serialization as S; spy DeltaResult kwargs; diff=DeepDiff(l1,l2); live=diff._iterable_opcodes; d=diff._to_delta_dict(directed=True, always_include_values=False); internal=seen['opcodes']; assert internal is not live; internal[key].append(...); assert live == snapshot

triple.copy_timepoint: _to_delta_dict call timepoint capture of live snapshot before serialization
triple.is_identity: result-side opcodes are not the live store (internal is not live)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: append on result side leaves live store untouched (and would leak if aliased)

mechanism_evidence.trigger: Serialize a directed delta and mutate the result side.
